name: A10-0010/2025 – David McAllister – § 76 – Am 10
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 76. Expresses concerns about certain aspects of the EU-Mercosur association agreement; emphasises the need for stronger protections for EU farmers, including a robust safeguard clause, and better alignment with EU standards; also raises concerns about the rebalancing mechanism and, in this regard, underlines that the EU-Mercosur agreement should not be ratified as it stands;
